# Task X contract test fixtures

These four documents exercise date-query, browse-query, local-preferences and sort-capabilities schema shapes. They are test-only adaptations of W1 #489 fixtures, with the actual Task X index/taxonomy revisions and explicit REGION sort. They are not a live query result, stored user preferences or production capability advertisement. No fixture appears in the research asset manifest. SCORE/DISTANCE remain disabled; timezone is UNKNOWN and the date query is NOT_EVALUABLE.

The real Place/topic documents live in data/v2/indexes/research/. Synthetic multi-region memberships exist only inside a test method, never in those files. Exact W1 source is declared in source-lock.json; no W1 files are modified or assumed merged.
